name: legal-terminus-monorepo
description: Legal Terminus - Workflow Management Portal & Backend

scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:portal
scripts.cleanup:ports: lsof -ti :5001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; lsof -ti :5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; lsof -ti :5174 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; echo '✅ Cleaned up ports 5001, 5173, 5174'
scripts.dev:all: npm run cleanup:ports && concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:portal"
scripts.dev:e2e: npm run cleanup:ports && concurrently --names backend,portal --kill-others "npm run start:backend:e2e" "npm run dev:portal"
scripts.start:backend: lsof -ti :5001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; cd backend && npm start
scripts.start:backend:e2e: lsof -ti :5001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; cd backend && EMAIL_DISABLED=true npm start
scripts.dev:backend: lsof -ti :5001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: lsof -ti :5174 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; cd Frontend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:portal: lsof -ti :5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; cd Portal && npm run dev
scripts.dev:portal-only: lsof -ti :5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; cd Portal && npm run dev
scripts.test: npm run cleanup:ports && concurrently --kill-others-on-success "npm run start:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "sleep 5 && cd Frontend && npm run test:pages"
scripts.test:headed: npm run cleanup:ports && concurrently --kill-others-on-success "npm run start:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "sleep 5 && cd Frontend && npm run test:pages:headed"

author: Legal Terminus
